## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:identity` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T15:03Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** after a refused switch, the header names a workspace the server no longer has active, so org-scoped screens act on a context the user cannot see is gone. The refusal itself is right, and nothing is exposed.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. The header reads the server's active-organization answer after reload. ⛔ It does not re-assert the cached one.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p2`, `area:identity`; triage first grade `6218366640`)
Session: `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`
Account: `baozhoutao` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12698-stale-active-org`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12698`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx` (`refreshOrganizations` and how the active organization is derived after a reload); `packages/auth/src/ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts` only if the stale value is held there; `packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx` only where the header reads the active organization; tests beside each; one `.changeset/12698-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report). ⛔ Not `LoginForm.tsx` or `SocialSignInButtons.tsx` (open PR objectui#12761).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate for these paths)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui @object-ui/auth: the client keeps or re-derives an active organization the server no longer reports (measured first: a client-held value never cleared, or the single-membership repair) | the server's own NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION answer, which the shell already has a state for (ConsoleShell.tsx :405) | any member whose session loses its active organization (a refused switch, a removed membership); seen live on the stock showcase by objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878`
Thread-read: 6218366640
Serial constraints cleared: scanned every open objectui PR's file list just now. The only `packages/auth` PR is objectui#12761 (seat 3's objectui#12682: `LoginForm.tsx`, `SocialSignInButtons.tsx`), which is disjoint from this surface. This seat's in-flight work touches the marketplace page (PR #12763) and the grid seam (PR #12756), both disjoint.
**Revised 2026-10-16T19:05Z (seat ruling on the dev's open question in os-dev report `6222585880`):** the surface adds `packages/app-shell/src/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/src/layout/CurrentOrganizationIndicator.tsx`, with tests beside them. The measured cause is two client guesses: the stored id survives a server "none" (fixed in `AuthProvider`), and both header components render `activeOrganization ?? orgList[0]`. Ruling: option A. Drop the `?? orgList[0]` fallback in both. With no server-active organization, the header shows the existing no-organization-context state, and org-scoped routes keep redirecting through `RequireOrganization`. No new copy, no new state, no export change. The same PR then closes the card. Serial check: no open objectui PR touches either component (scanned 2026-10-16T19:04Z).
Claimed at: 2026-10-16T18:43Z

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-16T19:45Z

PR #12765 merged through the merge queue as `6e141d9`, which is on `main`. Verified by content: all 7 of the PR's files on `origin/main` are blob-identical to the accepted head `a405599`. The squash commit's message names no model.

What landed: after a refused organization switch and a reload, the console follows the server's answer.
- `AuthProvider` clears the stored organization id when the server reports no active organization, so the old id no longer stamps `X-Tenant-ID` or keys the metadata cache.
- The header's switcher and current-organization indicator name only the server-active organization. They no longer fall back to the first membership.
- The ADR-0081 single-membership repair is unchanged: it was already truthful.

Acceptance note, not filed: a stored id with zero memberships is not cleared, because `refreshOrganizations` skips the server call then. It was not measured as reachable.

`pm:dispatched` leaves with this note. The card closed `completed` on merge.
